[EN] The Gulas' Secret Treasure
[ES] El tesoro secreto de los gulas
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] No, no, X doesn't mark the spot. I used circles instead.
[ES] No, no, la X no marca el lugar. En su lugar usé círculos.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] I love the anticipation before opening a treasure chest.
[ES] Me encanta la expectación antes de abrir un cofre del tesoro.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Take the chest.
[ES] Llévate el cofre.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Search for the frozen chest around the shipwreck, Batia's Hulk, east of Frostclaw Lake.
[ES] Busca el cofre congelado alrededor del naufragio, el Casco de Batia, al este de Frostclaw Lake.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Bosun's Old Key
[ES] Llave vieja de contramaestre
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Obtain keys from the drowned gula bosuns around Frostclaw Lake.
[ES] Obtén llaves de los contramaestres gulas ahogados alrededor de Frostclaw Lake.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Deliver the keys and chest to Tantan.
[ES] Entrega las llaves y el cofre a Tantan.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] "What's inside?"
[ES] "¿Qué hay dentro?"
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] "I'll take it!"
[ES] "¡Me lo quedo!"
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] The chest is open. Speak to Tantan again.
[ES] El cofre está abierto. Habla con Tantan de nuevo.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Tantan
[ES] Tantan
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Mysterious Map
[ES] Mapa misterioso
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Find Yasper at the Beacon Point Garrison.
[ES] Encuentra a Yasper en la Guarnición de Beacon Point.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] "Thank you!"
[ES] "¡Gracias!"
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026
